de.name: United Pentecostal Church
de.text: Diese Pfingstkirche dient den Gemeinden des Agusan-Flusstals und veranstaltet lebendige christliche Gottesdienste.

de.name: Seventh Day Adventist Church
de.text: Dieses Gotteshaus in der Agusan-Flussregion bietet der lokalen Gemeinde der Siebenten-Tags-Adventisten einen Zufluchtsort.

de.name: Kingdom Hall of Jehovah's Witnesses
de.text: Dieser Königreichssaal dient als ausgewiesener christlicher Treffpunkt für die Zeugen Jehovas, die im Agusan-Flusstal leben.

de.name: St. Stanislaus Kostka Parish Church
de.text: Diese katholische Pfarrkirche ist einem polnischen Jesuitenheiligen gewidmet und betreut die Gläubigen in der Region des Agusan-Flusses.

hu.name: United Pentecostal Church
hu.text: Az Agusan-folyó völgyének közösségeit szolgáló pünkösdi templom élénk keresztény istentiszteleteknek ad otthont.

hu.name: Seventh Day Adventist Church
hu.text: Az Agusan-folyó régiójában található istentiszteleti hely menedéket nyújt a helyi hetednapi adventista gyülekezet számára.

hu.name: Kingdom Hall of Jehovah's Witnesses
hu.text: Ez a Királyság-terem a Jehova Tanúi kijelölt keresztény találkozóhelyeként szolgál az Agusan-folyó völgyében.

hu.name: St. Stanislaus Kostka Parish Church
hu.text: Egy lengyel jezsuita szentnek szentelt katolikus plébániatemplom, amely az Agusan-folyó környékének híveit szolgálja.

ro.name: United Pentecostal Church
ro.text: Deservind comunitățile din Valea Râului Agusan, această biserică penticostală găzduiește slujbe de închinare creștină pline de viață.

ro.name: Seventh Day Adventist Church
ro.text: Situat în regiunea râului Agusan, acest lăcaș de cult oferă un sanctuar pentru congregația locală a Adventiștilor de Ziua a Șaptea.

ro.name: Kingdom Hall of Jehovah's Witnesses
ro.text: Această Sală a Regatului servește drept loc de întâlnire creștin desemnat pentru Martorii lui Iehova care locuiesc în Valea Râului Agusan.

ro.name: St. Stanislaus Kostka Parish Church
ro.text: Dedicată unui sfânt iezuit polonez, această biserică parohială catolică slujește credincioșilor din zona râului Agusan.

en.name: United Pentecostal Church
en.text: Serving the communities of the Agusan River Valley, this Pentecostal church hosts lively Christian worship services.

en.name: Seventh Day Adventist Church
en.text: Located within the Agusan River region, this place of worship provides a sanctuary for the local Seventh-day Adventist congregation.

en.name: Kingdom Hall of Jehovah's Witnesses
en.text: This Kingdom Hall serves as the designated Christian meeting place for Jehovah's Witnesses residing in the Agusan River Valley.

en.name: St. Stanislaus Kostka Parish Church
en.text: Dedicated to a Polish Jesuit saint, this Catholic parish church ministers to the faithful in the Agusan River area.
